utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Kira, I’m pulling folks together for the repair drive by the community center—if you can make it, I’d love to count you in, and feel free to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time and exact location first? I’d rather have the details nailed down before I commit or pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—it’ll be by the community center most of the afternoon, and I’m just locking down the exact start time now; I’ll send you the precise details before you share it around.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out and about, but if you’ve got an update on the repair drive, I’m all ears.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah—repair drive’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, and I’m telling everyone to bring any useful tools or spare parts so we get a solid turnout.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds great—thanks for spreading the word; I’m still chasing errands, but I can keep mentioning we still need duct tape, mixed screws, and a couple of work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rey, we’ve still got six homes to cover, and Gus is set to come by around nine for the gutters. Can you help me match the remaining houses with whoever’s available so we’ve got a clear plan?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah—I can help with that; tell me who’s already assigned, and I’ll help sort the remaining houses.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. Right now I’ve only got Gus lined up for the gutters at nine, so let’s list the six homes and match the other five with whoever’s free.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye—before we spread the word, can we confirm the date and whether it’s just the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps for now?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes—let’s stick with Saturday around 9:30 after school drop-off, and for now just the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps so I’m free by pickup.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect—Saturday at 9:30 works, and I’ve got just the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps noted for now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps—if Mara’s the one coordinating, I’ll check with her before I bring anything over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, good call—just have Mara text me what needs hauling and where, and I’ll swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, I’ll let Mara know—you’d probably save us a lot of back-and-forth if you can haul things over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m asking around today to pull in a few handy neighbors for the repair drive, but we still need the date nailed down so I can give people something concrete.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late on that part, Jules, but the only confirmed jobs I heard were the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot—those are concrete enough to start with, so I’ll keep gathering names and point folks toward tools for wood repairs while we wait on the date.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Pia, can you remind me—it's Saturday at 9 by the shed, right? I've got gloves on my mind, if I can find them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, Saturday at 9 by the shed, but please use the side street for parking and watch for the drop-off signs—I just want to make sure things don’t bottleneck.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the side street and the drop-off signs, got it. Thanks for the reminder; I’d probably have missed that today.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Leo, I’m organizing the repair drive for Saturday morning at the community center, and Mara’s coming early while Jules is lining up a few handy neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ve already got my lamp rewiring and bike brake cable on the list, and I can help sort tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Leo—I’ve got you down for lamp rewiring, the bike brake cable, and tool sorting when you arrive at the community center Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I heard they’re setting up by the community hall, near the side entrance. I’m keeping it quiet, but you can count me in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli—I appreciate it. We’re hauling busted bikes and scrap wood over to the community center lot by noon, so I’ll count you in there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright... thanks. I’ll bring what I can and keep to the side.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Mina, last I heard they’re setting up by the community hall’s side entrance, and they’re planning clear drop-off signs by the lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—who’s handling the signs, and what still needs to be dropped off there today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I only heard they were planning the signs—I didn’t catch who’s making them, but folks have been gathering tools and spare parts to drop off today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Cleo, I nearly muddled it again—it’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, and I know the garden bench still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll note the garden bench for Saturday morning, and I’ve still got gloves, tape, nails, cords, and two tarps on hand if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’s a relief, Cleo—thank you. And unless I’ve mixed it up again, Rey said they’d look at the squeaky gate first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll be there around nine with the ladder and drill, and we can start with the gutters.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Gus—I’ll be there early at the community center Saturday, so nine works well, and starting with the gutters makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Mara—I’ll swing by at nine with the ladder and drill, and we’ll get those gutters sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I heard they’re setting up by the community hall, near the side entrance. I’m keeping it quiet, but you can count me in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good to know — bring whatever basic tools you can, and we’ll sort the rest by the hall entrance.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I can do that—I'll just drop them by the side entrance and keep my head down.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s what I’ve got on my list so far: work gloves, duct tape, nails, extension cords, and two tarps. If you’ve heard the same, we can check what’s still missing next.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, can you confirm that’s the full list so far before we start calling anything missing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, that’s the full supplies list I have right now: work gloves, duct tape, nails, extension cords, and two tarps.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Rosa—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I’m finalizing the list now, so could you help me confirm which neighbors still need supplies versus actual repairs?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—send me the latest list, and I’ll help sort who needs supplies versus hands-on repairs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hana, we’ve got about six homes left, and Gus is coming by at nine with the ladder and drill, so I’d like to make a clear list of who can take each house before we start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli—before we assign the last six, can you confirm whether we’re still just working from the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, or if any other repairs have been firmly added?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: As of now, the only firm jobs I’ve got written down are the fence fix, Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps, and the gutters once Gus gets here at nine; let’s keep the list to confirmed work so we can assign the six homes cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Opal—that still works for me, and I’ll come early Saturday morning at the community center to help set up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Mara—Saturday morning at the community center is locked in, and I appreciate you coming early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Glad to hear it, Opal—I’ll plan to be there early Saturday morning, and I can check in with Faye and Quinn so we’re all lined up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—around 9:30 at the community center lot, and I’ll bring the drill and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Bo—that sounds right, and I’m glad you’ve got the drill; I’d probably have mixed up the time again.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No problem—just point me at the busted bikes and scrap wood when I get there, and I’ll haul what I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still catching up, Ira, but I’ve heard they’re collecting tools and a bit of cash, and the confirmed jobs are the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That helps, thanks—I’m still out on errands, but I know we still need a box of mixed screws, and Mina’s already covering the duct tape and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good to know—since I came in late, that box of mixed screws is the main thing I’ll remember to mention if anyone asks what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, what still needs fixing for the repair drive, and what can I take off your list today?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Mina — the repair drive’s this Saturday morning at the community lot, and I’m telling everyone to bring useful tools or spare parts once Cleo finishes checking what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, but what are you still short on right now, and do you want me to coordinate tools, spare parts, or both?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps some, but I still want to confirm the storage spot and who’s handling the drop-off signs before the weekend gets busy.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good call—I know Opal’s tracking the logistics, so I can check with her about the storage spot and the drop-off signs and loop you in today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules—that would ease my mind. If Opal can confirm the storage spot and who’s placing the signs, we’ll be in much better shape.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Tess, I’m still only hearing second-hand updates—do you know if Mara’s the one keeping the repair drive list, or are folks still just collecting tools, supplies, and money?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I’ve heard, folks are still mostly pooling tools, spare parts, and a bit of money by word of mouth—I haven’t heard for sure that Mara’s keeping the list, but I can keep asking around.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps a bit—I just don’t want to bring the wrong thing, so if you hear whether Mara’s got a list, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s still pretty loose, but I know the bench by the garden and the squeaky gate still need fixing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it—morning still works best for me around school pickup, so would Saturday around 9:30 be good for the bench and gate?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Saturday at 9:30 sounds good to me; I can let Rosa know that bench and gate are covered for then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks again, Gus—Saturday at 9 by the shed, right? I’m trying not to lose the thread here.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, Saturday at 9 by the shed—I’ll bring the ladder and drill, so you’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right—9 by the shed, thanks. I’ll try to track down my gloves before then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane — I’m tightening up the repair drive list now; can you help me confirm which neighbors still need actual repairs and which just need supplies?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I came in late, so the only actual repairs I can confirm are the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps; I just heard they’re still collecting tools and a little cash for supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — I’ve got the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps under repairs, and I’ll mark tools and cash as supply needs for now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—still planning to swing by around 9:30 with the drill and gloves, then haul busted bikes and scrap wood to the community center lot by noon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll be there from 9 by the shed, so just come by when you get in and we’ll put the drill to use.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—I’ll head to the shed when I get in and we’ll load up whatever needs hauling.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Morning, Nell — I’m still planning to swing by around nine with the drill and ladder so we can get started on the gutters.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Morning, Gus — I only heard bits and pieces, but are folks still collecting tools and a little money for the repair drive too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that’s still the plan—I’ll bring the drill and ladder, and I can toss in a little for the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but we still need duct tape, a box of mixed screws, and a couple of work gloves if anyone can grab them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira—I’ll add duct tape, mixed screws, and a couple pairs of work gloves to the list, and we’ll sort who can pick them up once everyone checks in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks Eli—that takes a load off while I’m out. If anyone asks, Quinn said they’ll be by the community center most of the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I commit, can you confirm the time, place, and what supplies are already covered for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Right now I’m aiming for Saturday around 9:30 at the repair drive site, with Bo bringing a drill and gloves; late morning still works best for me as long as I’m free by school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you pin down the exact location and confirm whether Cleo’s list still stands too—work gloves, duct tape, nails, extension cords, and two tarps?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Pia, I’ve got my supply notes ready—tell me what the repair drive is still short on, and I’ll check what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo—before we add more supplies, can we confirm where donations will be dropped off and stored, and who’s already bringing tools?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good call—let’s confirm the drop-off spot and storage first, then I’ll cross-check my notes on who’s already bringing tools so we don’t duplicate anything.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, we’re getting the repair drive together by the community center this afternoon—if you can make it, I’d love for you to come by and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can stop by the community center this afternoon and bring the street-by-street signup sheet, and I’ll keep an eye out for those last Maple Court volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be perfect, Opal—thanks for bringing the signup sheet, and let me know if you spot those Maple Court folks so we can fold them in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, are we still short on tools or supplies for the repair drive, and what can I pick up today?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think we’re still a little light on basics, so grab work gloves, screen patches, and a box of assorted screws if you can. I’m also checking with Opal so we’ve got the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I’ll pick up work gloves, screen patches, and assorted screws. Do you need a specific glove size or screw range, or should I just get standard basics?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Tess, Saturday morning at the community center still works for me, and I can get there early to help set up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s lovely, Mara—last I heard they’re setting up by the community hall near the side entrance, and folks should be using the side street for parking.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s helpful, Tess—I'll plan to come in early by the side entrance and let people know to use the side street for parking.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: From what I’ve heard, the bench by the garden and the squeaky gate still need attention, and I’m not sure who’s covering supplies for those yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, yeah, Saturday at 9 by the community shed, I think. Gus said he’s bringing the drill and ladder, and I’ll try to find my gloves before then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That helps—sounds like tools are mostly covered, so I just need to check who can bring parts for the bench and gate.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren—so we’ve only confirmed the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps so far, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think so, Hana—unless I’m muddling it up again, the bench by the garden and that squeaky gate still need someone to check.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That matches what I have too—just the fence fix and Mrs. Alvarez’s porch steps confirmed, and the bench by the garden plus the squeaky gate still need checking.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
